folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B395: checkpoint substance and retained evidence depth
folds.body:
The full T1–T15 checkpoints were reviewed against the current wave routing, not just their completion labels. Their early started, missing-report, worktree, process, reservation, viewport and test-count lines remain chronological observations. T12/T13 already carry their recovered completed disposition. T6 pure-module evidence and T9 QA design are distinct from the later T16 merged QA delivery. The old one-realm/one-prestige gate in T2/T7 is retired; current lead-first direction retains later independent beginnings. Human review is optional under AD42, and current AD36 controls required checks.

Retain substantive distinctions for later selected research work. T8's immutable root must not be replaced by a moving RNG cursor, and bounded recent history does not become durable invention provenance. T11 separates market saturation from actual adoption and truth primitives from received evidence; dynamic description hooks and a special-case maker stamp do not supply general diffusion or provenance. T12's spacing/retrieval findings support optional learning texture without chores, mandatory forgetting or a claimed universal beginner-luck effect. T4's historical mechanisms retain body/excerpt and interpretation boundaries; T3 preserves the important example of translation changing understanding without necessarily blocking plot progress.

T5/T7 graph counts and feasibility witnesses do not supply materials, actual learned procedure, innate body/source or a native output consumer. T9's six syntax-checked snippets were not executed regression tests. Its independent oracle, shrinking, golden witnesses, contextual lint, immutable receipts and censored budget results remain useful QA ideas for a selected contract. T10's 76 cue ladders remain optional knowledge/sense-dependent presentation, with no gameplay or visual proof from their count.

T14's 60 draft cards had 54 structural passes and six expected unknown-panel rejections. Preserve the actual panel decisions instead of forcing an unsuitable allowed panel to obtain a green validator result. In-memory grant and JSON equality do not establish a real acquisition, observation or durable native effect. T15's 12 Markdown cards did not run that validator; official summaries, author passages, indexed secondary extracts and exact unverified comic panels retain different source depth. No source acquisition, runtime LLM choice, inspector, schema allocation, research wave or native feature is selected by these checkpoints.
